description: This file defines a GTK-based GUI component, specifically a Rectangle class for device visualization in a graphical interface, including device property icons and size handling.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A GTK RadioButton subclass representing a device rectangle with icons and labels for visualization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Rectangle widget with device info, size, icons, and label.

methods.name: _add_device_icons
methods.description: Creates a vertical box of device property icons based on device properties.

methods.name: _get_device_properties
methods.description: Determines device properties for icon display based on device attributes.
